title: osmia ferruginea
intro: Osmia ferruginea, commonly known as the "rusty bee plant", is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Osmia ferruginea include relaxing muscles, reducing pain and inflammation, and alleviating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Osmia ferruginea include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
